main.remarks: An immutable record describing a tool-scoped operation schema.

property.name: AccessKeyRealmID
property.summary: Access key realm identifier for tokens issued from this manifest.

property.name: ManifestHash
property.summary: Deterministic manifest hash computed from the tool schema identifier, tool schema version, and ordered operation definitions.

method.name: Equals
method.summary: Determine whether this instance references the same ToolManifest.
method.returns: True if both references point to the same instance.

method.name: Create
method.summary: Create ToolManifest from a tool using the tool type full name as the default schema identifier, default access-key realm identifier, and tool type, with an empty default tool schema version.

method.name: CreateSchema
method.summary: Create ToolManifest from explicit schema values without computing the manifest hash.
method.param: Access key realm identifier. Null defaults to the tool schema identifier.

method.name: ComputeManifestHash
method.summary: Compute a deterministic manifest hash from the tool schema identifier, tool schema version, and ordered operation definitions.
method.returns: The current manifest instance with populated if it was not already set.

method.name: TryParse
method.returns: True if input was parsed successfully.
